learning_outcomes.text: Explain EVM principles and the performance measurement baseline
Compute the core EVM values PV, EV and AC
Calculate schedule and cost performance indices
Forecast completion using EAC, ETC and TCPI
Interpret EVM results and report performance

integrative_case: At the midpoint of a construction package, a project is reporting high spend but a manager suspects it is also behind. The controls analyst must compute PV, EV, AC, variances and indices, forecast the estimate at completion, calculate the TCPI needed to hit budget, and present an honest health assessment to the sponsor.
